scope.rationale: D176.6 closes the collection task: it adds the C08 focused JSON-stream-phase2 benchmark (new compiled benchmark source + a benchmark-only InternalsVisibleTo) and runs six isolated manual mutations against the JSON writer/preparer. The mutated compiled inputs are the recursive writer (JsonRowWriterFactory), the shape plan/classifier (JsonShapePlan) and the JSON-only preparer (QueryCommand.QueryPreparer); the affected filtered tests are the core direct-writer suite (JsonShapeWriterTests) and the SQLite end-to-end suite (JsonStreamingTests). Product changes for earlier units already exist in the working tree; this unit only mutates-then-restores them.
